title.zh: 将卡马里内斯苏尔省戈阿市描笼涯圣胡安包蒂斯塔起，经描笼涯塔贡通、阿布卡扬、希瓦克洛伊、迪格迪贡、巴拉伊南与帕亚坦；廷纳巴克市描笼涯卢皮、蒂埃拉内瓦达、比纳莱、卡马贡、萨尔瓦西翁、圣罗克、圣拉蒙、萨克拉达、拉梅达利亚、马格赛赛与圣维森特；至西鲁马市描笼涯纳拉亚汉止的国家公路，命名为阿努尔福·“诺利”·丰特贝拉议长公路的法案
title.en: An Act Naming the National Highway, Stretching From Barangay San Juan Bautista, Traversing Through Barangays Tagongtong, Abucayan, Hiwacloy, Digdigon, Balaynan and Payatan in the Municipality of Goa, Barangays Lupi, Tierra Nevada, Binalay, Camagong, Salvacion, San Roque, San Ramon, Sagrada, La Medalla, Magsaysay and San Vicente in the Municipality of Tinambac, Up to Barangay Nalayahan in the Municipality of Siruma, All in the Province of Camarines Sur, as Speaker Arnulfo “Noli” Fuentebella Highway

title.vi: Đạo luật đặt tên Đường Quốc lộ từ Barangay San Juan Bautista, qua các Barangay Tagongtong, Abucayan, Hiwacloy, Digdigon, Balaynan và Payatan thuộc Thị xã Goa; các Barangay Lupi, Tierra Nevada, Binalay, Camagong, Salvacion, San Roque, San Ramon, Sagrada, La Medalla, Magsaysay và San Vicente thuộc Thị xã Tinambac; đến Barangay Nalayahan thuộc Thị xã Siruma, tất cả đều ở Tỉnh Camarines Sur, là Đường cao tốc Chủ tịch Hạ viện Arnulfo "Noli" Fuentebella
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติกำหนดชื่อทางหลวงแผ่นดินที่เริ่มจากบารังไกย์ซานฮวนบาโอติสตาผ่านบารังไกย์ตากองตงอับกาเยนฮิวาคลอยดิกดิกอนบาลายนันและพาเยตันในเทศบาลโกอาบารังไกย์ลูปีเตียร์ราเนวาดามินาลายคามากองซัลวาซิออนซานโรเกซานรามอนซากราดาลาเมดาเลียมักไซซายและซานวิเซนเตในเทศบาลตินัมบักถึงบารังไกย์นาลายาฮันในเทศบาลซีรูมาทั้งหมดในจังหวัดกามารีเนสซูร์เป็นทางหลวงประธานสภาผู้แทนราษฎรอาร์นุลโฟโนลีเฟือนเตเบยา
title.id: Undang-Undang Memberi Nama Jalan Nasional yang Membentang dari Barangay San Juan Bautista, Melalui Barangay Tagongtong, Abucayan, Hiwacloy, Digdigon, Balaynan dan Payatan di Kotamadya Goa; Barangay Lupi, Tierra Nevada, Binalay, Camagong, Salvacion, San Roque, San Ramon, Sagrada, La Medalla, Magsaysay dan San Vicente di Kotamadya Tinambac; Hingga Barangay Nalayahan di Kotamadya Siruma, Semuanya di Provinsi Camarines Sur, sebagai Jalan Tol Ketua DPR Arnulfo "Noli" Fuentebella
title.ms: Akta Memberi Nama Lebuhraya Kebangsaan yang Membentang dari Barangay San Juan Bautista, Melalui Barangay Tagongtong, Abucayan, Hiwacloy, Digdigon, Balaynan dan Payatan di Perbandaran Goa; Barangay Lupi, Tierra Nevada, Binalay, Camagong, Salvacion, San Roque, San Ramon, Sagrada, La Medalla, Magsaysay dan San Vicente di Perbandaran Tinambac; Hingga Barangay Nalayahan di Perbandaran Siruma, Semuanya di Wilayah Camarines Sur, sebagai Lebuhraya Ketua Dewan Perwakilan Rakyat Arnulfo "Noli" Fuentebella

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2024/ra_11990_2024.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The National Highway, stretching from Barangay San Juan Bautista, traversing through Barangays Tagongtong, Abucayan, Hiwacloy, Digdigon, Balaynan and Payatan in the Municipality of Goa, Barangays Lupi, Tierra Nevada, Binalay, Camagong, Salvacion, San Roque, San Ramon, Sagrada, La Medalla, Magsaysay and San Vicente in the Municipality of Tinambac, up to Barangay Nalayahan in the Municipality of Siruma, all in the Province of Camarines Sur, is hereby named as Speaker Arnulfo "Noli" Fuentebella Highway.
The Department of Public Works and Highways shall issue the necessary rules, orders, and circulars to implement the provisions of this Act within sixty (60) days from its effectivity.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
